name: Archive
flavor_text: It's not just memory augmentation; it's neural architecture. Serialize data, keep it by your side - secure, encrypted, and utterly discreet.
effect: The user always has data storage at hand. The connector can be found with a -30 Investigation test - if it is technically possible.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Carbonhide
flavor_text: In a world where firepower escalates by the quarter, flesh is a liability - unless it's \emph{AegisDerm}. Bullet, blade, heat, or blunt trauma - AegisDerm absorbs, deflects, and outlasts. No downtime. No exo-rig. No extra weight. Just you, harder to kill.
effect: Can be activated/deactivated during the Declaration Phase. While active, the user has +18 armor but suffers 1 Exhaustion for every hit taken.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Cat Legs
slogan: The ground is not your limit.
flavor_text: Engineered using adaptive microservo arrays and our patented physical force capacitors, the OLYMPIA-series brings you enhanced jump velocity, leap distance, and impact resilience.
effect: Jump and leap distances are doubled. The distance for calculation of fall damage (when landing under at least some control) is reduced to a quarter.
mods: Aesthetic, Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Wrongly fitted, Compartment

name: Deadeye
slogan: One Shot. One Hit. Again and Again.
flavor_text: Eliminate uncertainty with the PRR, our fully integrated ocular augmentation suite built for the sharpshooter, the overwatch, the ghost with a kill list. Targets don't just fall - they're pre-defeated.
effect: Aim actions grant an additional +10 to the following shot. Both the shooter and the target can move at any speed and the aim bonus is not lost, as long as it remains visible.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Fear Jail
flavor_text: Introducing LockDown Neural Vault, an innovative implant designed to suppress irrational behavior and emotional outbursts in high-stress environments. Perfect for professionals navigating demanding roles like tech innovation in finance or critical decision-making in healthcare.
effect: The character gains the benefits of \emph{Broken}, stacking with the ability. He may never benefit from any positive disposition.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Firebreak
flavor_text: Shine in any situation! Housefires, carfires, arson - you are prepared with our patented coolant mesh. When everything else has been reduced to ashes, you and your pride will remain intact.
effect: Halves heat and fire damage (except lasers). Cannot catch on fire.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Holoskin
slogan: Uncertainty for them. Certainty for you.
flavor_text: By projecting a mesmerizing Holographic Mirage effect, this state-of-the-art technology makes your newly obscured form nearly impossible to hit, almost ensuring you remain unharmed.
effect: Grants -20 to attacks and parries against the user. The user suffers -20 to any tests made to hide while active. It can be activated as an action. \\ It has no effect when wearing armor or thick clothing.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Aesthetic

name: Junk Arm
flavor_text: Be ready for any danger, again and again. With its design, we reduce operational costs for healthcare providers, contributing to more efficient care delivery.
effect: The body part won't bleed and can't receive biotech implants or benefit from them. Zone HP is reduced to 20%. As long as the interface is not destroyed, an extremity can be replaced in 15 seconds (5 rounds). \\ Note: most mods are applied to the mount point but some may be applied to the limb instead as per GM discretion
cost: 40 to install the interface; cR 20 per limb
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: L1NC
slogan: Enter the world - become a part.
flavor_text: As the indispensable foundation for total neuro-digital integration, the Level One Neural Connector enables seamless biocircuit access, cybernetic compatibility, and real-time connection to the AR Net. With L1NC, the world doesn't just appear - it responds.
effect: The user is connected to the global AR network. Most important information is shared through it: Shopping windows, guides, traffic signs, to name a few. People without this implant essentially live in another world, and are generally suspicious within the city. \\ Due to its importance, the L1NC has been optimized to the extreme. It is the safest implant out there, having almost no load on the body. It is also shielded from EMP.
mods: None

name: Lifter Arms
flavor_text: HERCULES is here to revolutionize your physical capabilities with its cutting-edge augmentation designed for high-stakes environments. As an exclusive, state-of-the-art tool, HERCULES enhances lifting and carrying capacity, making every task effortlessly manageable.
effect: Strength for the purpose of determining carry weight, and on tests for slow feats of strength is increased by 40.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Perfect fit

name: Monkey Grip
flavor_text: Unbreakable grip with unending endurance - Toughgrip Climbing Arms are the latest in essential wasteland survival technology. No cliff too high, no peak out of reach.
effect: Grants a +15 bonus to climbing tests and other tests requiring grip strength.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Muscle RAM
slogan: The next level of muscle memory.
flavor_text: Never have you been more prepared for everything. NervousPredictor offers improved reaction time in every situation, be it sports, combat, or contract bridge.
effect: Grants +20 to all reaction tests. Enables the user to parry non-primitive ranged weapons. Feinting against the user is twice as effective.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Pain Inhibitors
flavor_text: In an era where high-stress environments demand peak performance, the Pain Inhibitor implant offers a revolutionary solution to chronic pain that could halt progress. Invest in a future-proof solution that elevates your professional performance by transforming the way you handle pain.
effect: The user suffers no pain or related effects. Due to removal of a natural inhibitor, the character suffers D5-2 dmg to a random location and D5 exhaustion at the end of every day he is active, ignoring injury threshold.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Rayleigh Fibers
flavor_text: Our cutting-edge technology replaces nerves with high-tech fibers capable of communicating at lightning speeds, allowing users to react with unrivaled precision and control. The closest you will get to seeing the future - available today!
effect: Grants +10 to all reaction tests. The character can dodge or parry non-primitive ranged weapons.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Reprocessor Stomach
flavor_text: A bespoke, artificially created digestive system, that dramatically enhances nutrient absorption and waste elimination. Experience unparalleled resilience in hostile environments. A strategic investment in long-term operational viability.
effect: The speed of starvation is reduced to a quarter.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit
_comment: move to some wasteland addon possibly, starvation is not a big component in core

name: Sludge Pump
flavor_text: The @market_name@ offer modular augmentation - a scalable architecture for integrated cardiac performance. With strategic deployment, the PowerHeart™ allows for exponential expansion of your internal processing matrix.
effect: Increases MT by 1. May be implanted up to 3 times.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit

name: Snake Eyes
flavor_text: HeatSense overlays your reality with thermal detail. Spot hidden threats, track targets in low light, see the heat of everything around you.
effect: Allows the user to see IR light like heat sources and IR lasers. This may grant +20 to finding hidden people.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Stained Retina
flavor_text: In today's world of intense light and digital overload, your vision can become your limiting factor. Experience the future with Ocular Flash Protection -  let us ensure you see clearly in a world of overstimulation.
effect: Grants +20 to resist overstimulation like blinding, deafening or pain. While eye-protection is by far the most common, variants exist for hearing, touch and even smell.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Tin Arm
flavor_text: These bio-compatible exoskeletal limbs represent the pinnacle of pragmatic augmentation. Crafted from reinforced polymer composites and micro-circuitry, DuraSyn™ offers superior tensile strength - vastly exceeding organic resilience.
effect: The body part won't bleed and can't receive biotech implants or benefit from them.
mods: Cheap, Compartment, Wrongly fitted, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Integrated Weaponry

name: Voice Makeup
slogan: Command attention. Command respect. Command the conversation.
flavor_text: Are you tired of sounding... ordinary? We're not just altering your voice; we're crafting a persona. Seamlessly integrate any voice - authoritative, seductive, comforting - directly into your neural pathways.
effect: Vocal Deceive, Intimidate or Performance tests gain +20.
mods: Cheap, Inconspicuous, Perfect fit, Wrongly fitted

name: Air Tanks
flavor_text: It isn't simply enlargement; it's optimized airflow architecture. Integrates seamlessly with your existing pulmonary system, dramatically increasing alveolar surface area and enhancing gas exchange efficiency.
effect: The user's exhaustion threshold is doubled.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Armor Skin
flavor_text: Utilizing micro-scale, self-assembling graphene composites, @market_name@ provides a solid increase in blunt force resistance and impact absorption. It's also virtually undetectable to the touch - feeling remarkably like your own skin.
effect: Grants +6 natural armor. When degrading (e.g. from \emph{Rending}), the implant does not have to be replaced, but requires an invasive restitching operation, resulting in recovery as if a new implant was installed.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Compound Eyes
flavor_text: Frankly, for those who demand absolute control over their environment, unparalleled awareness, and a truly expanded perspective... MAXVision is an investment in your future. A future where you see everything.
effect: Grants the user +30 to tests against being ambushed or surprised. The user's control area increases to 270°.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Cut Gunk Tank
flavor_text: Not merely a medical device; it's a bio-engineered marvel - a miniature, self-sustaining ecosystem designed to address one of humanity's oldest vulnerabilities: rapid blood loss.
effect: All bleeding is stopped the moment it begins. Chems last twice as long. These effects, as well as half the implant's load, are inhibited by most common anesthetics.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Eagle Eye / Sniffer
flavor_text: With the HyperRes series it isn't about seeing, hearing, or feeling more; it's about experiencing reality with unprecedented depth and nuance. Available variants: Echo (hearing), Pulse (touch), Prism (sight) and Fragrance (smell).
effect: Grants +20 to perception tests using one particular sense. The user suffers -20 to tests resisting overstimulation (like blinding, deafening or pain).
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous

name: Flash Clone Arm
flavor_text: The BioForge process utilizes advanced cellular replication and bioprinting techniques to cultivate a completely custom-designed limb within a controlled bioreactor environment. Expect unparalleled neural interface compatibility rate and full sensory feedback.
effect: A lost or broken body part is restored back to normal. \\ It is possible to grow an exact clone. This takes very long (\sim 4 months) but does not use any MT.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Integrated Weaponry

name: Gills
flavor_text: Strategic relocation is increasingly common. @market_name@ grants unparalleled aquatic mobility and respiration, facilitating covert operations, resource acquisition in submerged sectors, and personal exploration.
slogan: A gateway, not merely an adaptation.
effect: Allows the character to breathe under water.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous

name: Gyro Legs
flavor_text: Dynamic Movement Protocols: Enhanced agility for reconnaissance and pursuit. Structural Support Augmentation:  Maintain unwavering posture in unstable environments. Precision Manipulation: Achieve unparalleled dexterity for delicate tasks - data retrieval, wasteland prospecting, artistic expression. Command your balance.
effect: The character can now stand up in half the time (an action turns into a free action), won't fall over by himself and gains a +20 bonus to resist being knocked over. However he can no longer wear normal shoes.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough

name: Mucus
flavor_text: Presenting the @market_name@ - a proactive bio-defense matrix. Unlike reactive repair systems, the Aegis Veil generates an anticipatory kinetic barrier, subtly reinforcing your physical structure against potential trauma.
slogan: A proactive investment in personal security.
effect: The character gains 3 temporary HP on every zone, which don't contribute to degradation when lost. When they are lost, it takes a minute for them to regenerate. The user suffers the effects of Bane: Terrible Odor and Bane: Ugly.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Pheromone Glands
slogan: Invest in Bloom. Invest in connection.
flavor_text: Optimize your social resonance! Introducing Synesthesia Bloom - bio-engineered pheromone glands meticulously calibrated to enhance interpersonal connectivity. A subtle augmentation for the discerning individual seeking peak relational performance.
effect: Grants +20 to all friendly social tests - the bonus is +40 instead in enclosed rooms without airflow. If either the target or the user wears vac-sealed armor, the augment has no effect.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic

name: Regen Factor
flavor_text: Utilizing precise hormone release, our @market_name@ stimulates cellular regeneration with unparalleled efficiency. Scars vanish in hours, broken bones mend within days, and minor tissue damage is effectively erased.
effect: Once per day, if the character is not already malnourished or starving, the character may take 15 minutes of rest to gain natural healing and restore 2D5 exhaustion. The user will become extremely hungry afterwards and take a -20 penalty to most actions until he gets a meal.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Rubber Bones
slogan: Moving like you never moved before.
flavor_text: Traditional bone casing focuses on density and impact resistance - creating a rigid structure. Flexi Bone Mesh, however, utilizes interwoven carbon nanotube lattices infused with bio-reactive polymers. This creates a remarkably lightweight yet incredibly resilient skeletal framework that \emph{adapts} to movement.
effect: Grants +20 to all tests to squeeze through small spaces or out of grapples. Increases Movement Speed by 1. The user suffers -20 to resist getting knocked down. The zone's HP are halved.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough

name: Shadow Runners
slogan: Become the monster under your bed.
flavor_text: These aren't mere prosthetics; they represent a paradigm shift in kinetic acoustics. Utilizing advanced, proprietary dampening polymers and micro-vibration nullification technology, our @market_name@ effectively eliminate percussive sound generated by movement.
effect: Sound-related penalties on sneaking tests are halved, at least reduced by 10.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough, Powerful, Inconspicuous

name: Steelbones
flavor_text: Imagine withstanding blunt force trauma, resisting debilitating injuries, projecting an image of unwavering strength. It's a statement. A declaration. You are fragile no longer.
effect: Grants 6 armor to the location. Swimming tests suffer a -15 penalty and weight is increased by 10%.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Steelwire Nerves
flavor_text: We understand the cumulative strain of extensive cybernetic integration. Our @market_name@ utilizes targeted neuromodulation and advanced cognitive mapping to optimize neural pathways and mitigate CNS degradation.
effect: Increases RI by 1. May be implanted up to 3 times.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit

name: Swiftfingers
flavor_text: Utilizing specialized artificial nerves and biofeedback integration, the @market_name@ provides an unprecedented 30% increase in fine motor control and tactile sensitivity. Subjective reports indicate a profound shift in proprioception and creative potential.
effect: The user gains +10 Dex, -10 Str and +20 to tactile Perception using this arm.
mods: Cheap, Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Powerful, Tough, Inconspicuous, Integrated Weaponry

name: Toxin Filters
flavor_text: @market_name@ - the most advanced active toxin neutralization system. Utilizing bleeding-edge nano-receptor technology, it proactively identifies and binds to a vast spectrum of toxins - including neurotoxins, heavy metals, and synthetic pathogens - rendering them inert before they can reach your critical systems.
slogan: Secure your body. Breathe freely. Live safely.
effect: The user becomes immune to almost all toxins. This includes the detriments of any chems.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Tough, Inconspicuous

name: Wasteland Skin
flavor_text: The RadioAblative Mesh actively converts incoming ionizing radiation into thermal energy, dissipating the harmful effects, way before they reach a cellular level. Effective protection against ambient levels within the Wastelands reaches 98%, significantly reducing the risk of cellular degradation and mutation.
effect: Grants +40 to tests to resist radiation poisoning and +30 to tests against getting shocked. The user's augments are immune to EMP.
mods: Wrongly fitted, Perfect fit, Inconspicuous, Aesthetic
